+# Daily Grind analytics
+
+The homepage loads `analytics.js` with `defer`. Set the script's `data-endpoint`
+attribute in `index.html` to your telemetry collector (default: `/api/analytics`).
+This static repository does not implement that collector; the hosting application
+must accept JSON POST requests at the configured endpoint.
+
+Payloads contain a `page` pathname and an `events` array. Each event has a `type`
+(`page_view` or `click`) and a millisecond Unix `timestamp`. Clicks include the
+target tag, a bounded element ID, and the destination pathname for links. No
+cookies, persistent identifiers, page text, query strings, or fragments are read.
+
+Events share a trailing one-second debounce. At 25 events, a batch is scheduled
+immediately to bound memory and request size below deferred-request quotas.
+Native `fetchLater` requests are replaced as the batch grows; browsers without it
+use a timer and flush on hidden visibility or pagehide with low-priority keepalive
+fetches. Delivery is best effort, with no retries; quota errors drop the current
+batch and network errors do not affect page interactions.
+
+Run the isolated analytics checks with `node --test analytics.test.cjs`. No server
+or browser is required.

+# The Daily Grind
+
+Static homepage with encrypted, device-local delivery notes.
+
+## Build and checks
+
+- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
+- `pnpm run build` bundles the browser module to `assets/notes.js` (included so the existing static-site start command still works).
+- `pnpm test` checks encryption, tampering, wrong recipients, persistence, deletion, and concurrent recipient setup without a browser or server.
+
+Serve the root over HTTPS (or localhost). Encryption requires WebCrypto and IndexedDB. The form remains disabled if initialization fails; notes never fall back to unencrypted storage or submission.
+
+## Encryption and scope
+
+A device-local recipient is generated once. Each save encapsulates a new shared secret with ML-KEM-768 + X25519 (X-Wing), derives a non-exportable AES-256-GCM key with HKDF-SHA-256, and uses a random 96-bit IV and 128-bit authentication tag. Version, suite, recipient fingerprint, note ID, timestamp, capsule, and salt are authenticated. The pinned `@noble/post-quantum` implementation preserves hybrid protection when native WebCrypto KEM support is missing; the native adapter is selected only after a successful round-trip probe. No classical-only downgrade is used.
+
+IndexedDB stores the encrypted envelope, public key, and KEM private key encrypted under a non-exportable AES-GCM wrapping key. It also stores that wrapping CryptoKey through structured cloning. Raw KEM private bytes and shared secrets are wiped when practical. JavaScript cannot guarantee complete memory erasure. Anyone or any script with access to the browser profile/origin can decrypt; this feature does not provide an account login or protection from malicious same-origin scripts. Revealed text is hidden after 30 seconds and when the tab becomes hidden.
+
+This repository has no order API or delivery-team recipient. Notes are explicitly labeled as local only, and are not transmitted or attached to orders. An encrypted JSON export contains no private key, so it cannot recover a note after site data is cleared or be decrypted on another device. A production delivery integration must provision an authenticated delivery-team public key from a trusted HTTPS service, send only encrypted envelopes, and keep the team's private key outside customer browsers. Never ship a recipient private key in this static bundle.
+
+No browser verification or development/preview server is needed for the automated checks. Native KEM support is unavailable in the current Node test runtime, so those checks exercise the bundled hybrid implementation. IndexedDB tests use a storage emulator; they do not constitute browser compatibility testing.

+import { ml_kem768_x25519 as hybrid } from '@noble/post-quantum/hybrid.js';
+import { ml_kem768_x25519 as nativeHybrid } from '@noble/post-quantum/webcrypto.js';
+
+const encoder = new TextEncoder();
+export const SUITE = 'MLKEM768-X25519+HKDF-SHA256+AES-256-GCM';
+const protocol = 'daily-grind/delivery-note/v1';
+const random = (length) => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(length));
+export const toBase64 = (bytes) => btoa(String.fromCharCode(...bytes));
+export const fromBase64 = (text) => Uint8Array.from(atob(text), c => c.charCodeAt(0));
+let adapter;
+async function kem() {
+  // A real round-trip probe avoids relying on experimental API presence alone.
+  adapter ??= nativeHybrid.isSupported().then(supported => supported ? nativeHybrid : hybrid);
+  return adapter;
+}
+async function keyId(publicKey) {
+  return toBase64(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', publicKey)));
+}
+async function deriveKey(secret, salt, context) {
+  try {
+    const base = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', secret, 'HKDF', false, ['deriveKey']);
+    return await crypto.subtle.deriveKey({ name: 'HKDF', hash: 'SHA-256', salt,
+      info: encoder.encode(`${protocol}:${context}`) }, base,
+    { name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
+  } finally { secret.fill(0); }
+}
+const metadata = (envelope) => encoder.encode(JSON.stringify([
+  protocol, envelope.version, envelope.suite, envelope.recipientId, envelope.id,
+  envelope.createdAt, envelope.capsule, envelope.salt,
+]));
+
+export async function createRecipient() {
+  const { publicKey, secretKey } = await (await kem()).keygen();
+  // The fallback needs raw KEM bytes briefly. Never persist those bytes unwrapped.
+  const wrappingKey = await crypto.subtle.generateKey({ name: 'AES-GCM', length: 256 }, false, ['encrypt', 'decrypt']);
+  const iv = random(12);
+  const recipientId = await keyId(publicKey);
+  try {
+    const wrappedSecret = await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv,
+      additionalData: encoder.encode(`${protocol}:${recipientId}`) }, wrappingKey, secretKey);
+    return { publicKey, recipientId, wrappingKey, iv, wrappedSecret };
+  } finally { secretKey.fill(0); }
+}
+
+export async function encryptNote(recipient, note) {
+  if (!note.trim() || note.length > 1000) throw new Error('Enter a note of 1–1,000 characters.');
+  const { cipherText, sharedSecret } = await (await kem()).encapsulate(recipient.publicKey);
+  const salt = random(32);
+  const envelope = { version: 1, suite: SUITE, recipientId: await keyId(recipient.publicKey),
+    id: crypto.randomUUID(), createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), capsule: toBase64(cipherText),
+    salt: toBase64(salt), iv: toBase64(random(12)) };
+  const key = await deriveKey(sharedSecret, salt, envelope.recipientId);
+  const plaintext = encoder.encode(note);
+  try {
+    envelope.ciphertext = toBase64(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.encrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM',
+      iv: fromBase64(envelope.iv), additionalData: metadata(envelope), tagLength: 128 }, key, plaintext)));
+    return envelope;
+  } finally { plaintext.fill(0); }
+}
+
+export async function decryptNote(recipient, envelope) {
+  if (envelope.version !== 1 || envelope.suite !== SUITE ||
+      envelope.recipientId !== recipient.recipientId || fromBase64(envelope.iv).length !== 12 ||
+      fromBase64(envelope.salt).length !== 32 || fromBase64(envelope.capsule).length !== 1120) {
+    throw new Error('Invalid encrypted note.');
+  }
+  const secretKey = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: recipient.iv,
+    additionalData: encoder.encode(`${protocol}:${recipient.recipientId}`) }, recipient.wrappingKey, recipient.wrappedSecret));
+  let secret;
+  try { secret = await (await kem()).decapsulate(fromBase64(envelope.capsule), secretKey); }
+  finally { secretKey.fill(0); }
+  const key = await deriveKey(secret, fromBase64(envelope.salt), envelope.recipientId);
+  const plaintext = new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.decrypt({ name: 'AES-GCM', iv: fromBase64(envelope.iv),
+    additionalData: metadata(envelope), tagLength: 128 }, key, fromBase64(envelope.ciphertext)));
+  try { return new TextDecoder().decode(plaintext); }
+  finally { plaintext.fill(0); }
+}

+import { createRecipient, encryptNote, decryptNote } from './crypto.js';
+import { openNotes } from './storage.js';
+const form = document.querySelector('#note-form');
+const fieldset = document.querySelector('#note-controls');
+const input = document.querySelector('#delivery-note');
+const status = document.querySelector('#note-status');
+const saved = document.querySelector('#saved-note');
+const output = document.querySelector('#revealed-note');
+const reveal = document.querySelector('#reveal-note');
+const count = document.querySelector('#note-count');
+let vault, recipient, busy = false, hideTimer;
+const announce = (message, error = false) => {
+  status.textContent = message;
+  status.classList.toggle('error', error);
+};
+function hideNote() {
+  clearTimeout(hideTimer);
+  output.textContent = '';
+  output.hidden = true;
+  reveal.textContent = 'Reveal note';
+  reveal.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+}
+async function refresh() {
+  hideNote();
+  const envelope = await vault.read('note');
+  saved.hidden = !envelope;
+  if (envelope) document.querySelector('#saved-date').textContent = `Saved on this device · ${new Date(envelope.createdAt).toLocaleString()}`;
+}
+async function action(work) {
+  if (busy) return;
+  busy = true;
+  fieldset.disabled = true;
+  saved.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => button.disabled = true);
+  try { await work(); }
+  catch { announce('We couldn’t read or save the encrypted note. Try again or check browser storage permissions. If the note was changed or its key is missing, it cannot be revealed.', true); }
+  finally {
+    busy = false;
+    fieldset.disabled = false;
+    saved.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(button => button.disabled = false);
+  }
+}
+// Attach before asynchronous initialization. The disabled fieldset also fails closed if JS cannot load.
+form.addEventListener('submit', event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (!vault || busy) return;
+  if (!input.value.trim()) {
+    input.setCustomValidity('Enter delivery instructions before saving.');
+    input.reportValidity();
+    return;
+  }
+  const note = input.value;
+  action(async () => {
+    announce('Encrypting your note…');
+    const envelope = await encryptNote(recipient, note);
+    await vault.write('note', envelope);
+    input.value = '';
+    count.textContent = '0 / 1,000';
+    await refresh();
+    announce('Note encrypted and saved on this device. It has not been sent to a delivery team.');
+  });
+});
+input.addEventListener('input', () => {
+  input.setCustomValidity('');
+  count.textContent = `${input.value.length.toLocaleString()} / 1,000`;
+});
+reveal.addEventListener('click', () => {
+  if (!output.hidden) { hideNote(); return; }
+  action(async () => {
+    const envelope = await vault.read('note');
+    if (!envelope) { await refresh(); announce('No saved note on this device.'); return; }
+    output.textContent = await decryptNote(recipient, envelope);
+    output.hidden = false;
+    reveal.textContent = 'Hide note';
+    reveal.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
+    hideTimer = setTimeout(hideNote, 30000);
+    announce('Note revealed. It will hide after 30 seconds or when you leave this tab.');
+  });
+});
+document.querySelector('#delete-note').addEventListener('click', () => action(async () => {
+  await vault.write('note', undefined);
+  hideNote();
+  await refresh();
+  announce('Your saved encrypted note has been deleted from this device.');
+}));
+document.querySelector('#export-note').addEventListener('click', () => action(async () => {
+  const envelope = await vault.read('note');
+  if (!envelope) { await refresh(); announce('No saved note to export.'); return; }
+  const url = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([JSON.stringify(envelope, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' }));
+  const link = document.createElement('a');
+  link.href = url;
+  link.download = 'daily-grind-encrypted-note.json';
+  link.click();
+  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 1000);
+  announce('Encrypted note exported. The file contains no private key and cannot be opened on another device.');
+}));
+document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.hidden) hideNote(); });
+window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => { hideNote(); input.value = ''; });
+async function initialize() {
+  try {
+    if (!globalThis.isSecureContext || !crypto.subtle || !globalThis.indexedDB) {
+      throw new Error('Secure browser storage is unavailable.');
+    }
+    vault = await openNotes();
+    recipient = await vault.read('recipient');
+    if (!recipient) {
+      const candidate = await createRecipient();
+      try { await vault.write('recipient', candidate, true); }
+      catch (error) { if (error.name !== 'ConstraintError') throw error; }
+      recipient = await vault.read('recipient');
+    }
+    await refresh();
+    fieldset.disabled = false;
+    document.querySelector('#crypto-badge').textContent = 'Hybrid protection ready';
+    announce('Ready to encrypt. Your note stays on this device.');
+  } catch {
+    fieldset.disabled = true;
+    document.querySelector('#crypto-badge').textContent = 'Encryption unavailable';
+    announce('Encrypted notes need HTTPS and browser storage access. No note can be saved until both are available.', true);
+  }
+}
+initialize();

@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+const requestValue = (request) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+  request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+  request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+});
+export async function openNotes() {
+  const request = indexedDB.open('daily-grind-private-notes', 1);
+  request.onupgradeneeded = () => request.result.createObjectStore('vault');
+  request.onblocked = () => { /* The UI stays disabled until storage opens. */ };
+  const db = await requestValue(request);
+  db.onversionchange = () => db.close();
+  return {
+    async read(key) { return requestValue(db.transaction('vault').objectStore('vault').get(key)); },
+    // An add makes recipient setup race-safe across tabs: never replace a key.
+    async write(key, value, onlyIfAbsent = false) {
+      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+        const transaction = db.transaction('vault', 'readwrite');
+        const store = transaction.objectStore('vault');
+        if (value === undefined) store.delete(key);
+        else if (onlyIfAbsent) store.add(value, key);
+        else store.put(value, key);
+        transaction.oncomplete = () => resolve();
+        transaction.onabort = () => reject(transaction.error);
+        transaction.onerror = () => { /* onabort reports the failure. */ };
+      });
+    },
+  };
+}

+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { createRecipient, encryptNote, decryptNote, fromBase64, toBase64, SUITE } from '../src/crypto.js';
+
+test('hybrid envelope round-trips Unicode notes after recipient structured cloning', async () => {
+  const recipient = structuredClone(await createRecipient());
+  const text = 'Side gate: 4512. Please don’t ring ☕ 日本語';
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(recipient, text);
+  assert.equal(envelope.suite, SUITE);
+  assert.equal(fromBase64(envelope.capsule).length, 1120);
+  assert.equal(fromBase64(envelope.iv).length, 12);
+  assert.equal(recipient.wrappingKey.extractable, false);
+  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(envelope).includes('4512'), false);
+  assert.equal(await decryptNote(recipient, JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(envelope))), text);
+});
+
+test('each save has an independent capsule, salt, IV, ID and ciphertext', async () => {
+  const recipient = await createRecipient();
+  const a = await encryptNote(recipient, 'Bench by the door');
+  const b = await encryptNote(recipient, 'Bench by the door');
+  for (const field of ['capsule', 'salt', 'iv', 'id', 'ciphertext']) assert.notEqual(a[field], b[field]);
+});
+
+test('tampered ciphertext, metadata, capsule, salt and IV are rejected', async () => {
+  const recipient = await createRecipient();
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(recipient, 'Do not ring');
+  for (const field of ['ciphertext', 'capsule', 'salt', 'iv']) {
+    const bytes = fromBase64(envelope[field]);
+    bytes[0] ^= 1;
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(recipient, { ...envelope, [field]: toBase64(bytes) }));
+  }
+  for (const [field, value] of Object.entries({ id: 'other-order', createdAt: '2020-01-01',
+    recipientId: 'other-recipient', version: 2, suite: 'AES-GCM' })) {
+    await assert.rejects(decryptNote(recipient, { ...envelope, [field]: value }));
+  }
+});
+
+test('wrong recipient and damaged wrapped private key are rejected', async () => {
+  const recipient = await createRecipient();
+  const other = await createRecipient();
+  const envelope = await encryptNote(recipient, 'Leave by door');
+  await assert.rejects(decryptNote(other, envelope));
+  const bytes = new Uint8Array(recipient.wrappedSecret.slice(0));
+  bytes[0] ^= 1;
+  await assert.rejects(decryptNote({ ...recipient, wrappedSecret: bytes }, envelope));
+});
+
+test('empty and oversized notes are rejected', async () => {
+  const recipient = await createRecipient();
+  for (const note of ['', '  ', 'x'.repeat(1001)]) await assert.rejects(encryptNote(recipient, note));
+});

+import 'fake-indexeddb/auto';
+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { openNotes } from '../src/storage.js';
+import { createRecipient, encryptNote, decryptNote } from '../src/crypto.js';
+
+test('encrypted note and protected recipient survive a new storage connection', async () => {
+  const vault = await openNotes();
+  const recipient = await createRecipient();
+  await vault.write('recipient', recipient);
+  await vault.write('note', await encryptNote(recipient, 'Gate code 9832 ☕'));
+  const reopened = await openNotes();
+  const storedRecipient = await reopened.read('recipient');
+  const envelope = await reopened.read('note');
+  assert.equal(storedRecipient.wrappingKey.extractable, false);
+  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(envelope).includes('9832'), false);
+  assert.equal(await decryptNote(storedRecipient, envelope), 'Gate code 9832 ☕');
+  await reopened.write('note', undefined);
+  assert.equal(await vault.read('note'), undefined);
+});
+
+test('simultaneous first-time setup cannot overwrite the winning recipient', async () => {
+  const one = await openNotes();
+  const two = await openNotes();
+  await one.write('recipient', undefined);
+  const candidates = await Promise.all([createRecipient(), createRecipient()]);
+  const results = await Promise.allSettled([
+    one.write('recipient', candidates[0], true),
+    two.write('recipient', candidates[1], true),
+  ]);
+  assert.equal(results.filter(result => result.status === 'fulfilled').length, 1);
+  assert.equal(results.find(result => result.status === 'rejected').reason.name, 'ConstraintError');
+  const winner = results.findIndex(result => result.status === 'fulfilled');
+  assert.equal((await two.read('recipient')).recipientId, candidates[winner].recipientId);
+});

+# Forma landing page
+
+A dependency-free responsive landing page. Open `index.html` through your existing static hosting workflow. No build step is required.
+
+## Experiment integration
+
+An inline head script hides `#page` before the first paint. `app.js` assigns a persistent A/B hero variant while hidden, then loads the requested `https://cdn.example.com/experiment-sdk.js` in a sandboxed staging document containing the page markup.
+
+The SDK can read `window.experimentVariant` and modify the staging DOM. It must signal completion by dispatching `experiment:ready` on `window`, or expose `window.experimentSDK.ready` as a promise or a function returning a promise. A script load event alone does not prove asynchronous DOM changes are finished.
+
+On completion, the staged `.hero` is transferred to the live page before revealing it. On network error, initialization error, or a 1.8-second deadline, the staging frame is destroyed and the already assigned local variant is revealed. This prevents late SDK work from changing the fallback after reveal. Without JavaScript, the baseline content remains visible.
+
+The staging sandbox deliberately has an opaque origin: the SDK cannot access the parent, cookies, or local storage. Assignment is managed by the parent and supplied through `experimentVariant`. A production SDK requiring cookies, origin access, layout measurements, or changes outside `.hero` needs a corresponding integration adapter. The supplied example CDN is not assumed to provide a working SDK.
+
+## Interactions
+
+The primary CTA opens a validated email form. This demonstration saves interest in local storage and explicitly explains that no email was sent; it does not connect to a mailing service. The secondary CTA opens a product tour. Both dialogs support Escape and outside clicks.
+
+## Validation
+
+`node --check app.js` checks JavaScript syntax. No preview server or manual browser verification was used.

+# Rewards service integration
+
+This repository is a static site. The registration interface is implemented, but no accounts are created until a real same-origin service implements the endpoints below. There is no mock success, credential storage, or third-party form collector. Without JavaScript, submission is disabled and an explanation is displayed.
+
+## API contract
+
+- `GET /api/rewards/csrf`: return `200 application/json` with `{ "csrfToken": "<cryptographically random, session-bound token>" }`. Use `Cache-Control: no-store` and a `Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Lax` session cookie. Do not enable cross-origin credentialed access.
+- `POST /api/rewards/register`: accept JSON `{ full_name, email, password, marketing, terms }` and validate the `X-CSRF-Token` header against the session. Reject unexpected origins and unsupported content types. Return `201 application/json` with `{ "created": true }` only after creating the account and scheduling the verification email. Return non-2xx status codes for failures; use `429` for rate limiting. Never return passwords or echo submitted data in errors.
+
+The interface requires HTTPS, rejects redirects, times requests out after 15 seconds, and checks content types so that a static host's HTML fallback cannot masquerade as a successful registration. Request failures retain entries in the current form for retry; nothing is persisted across reloads. If a request's outcome is uncertain, the interface reports that registration was not confirmed.
+
+## Server requirements before launch
+
+Enforce every rule independently of browser validation: a nonempty Unicode name up to 100 characters, an email up to 254 characters, a password of 15–128 characters (accept spaces, Unicode and pasted passwords; do not trim it), explicit terms acceptance, and a boolean marketing preference defaulting to false. Keep client and server password length measurements consistent. Apply request body limits, abuse/rate limits, breached-password checks, email verification, secure password hashing such as Argon2id, and generic account errors that avoid revealing whether an email is registered. Support retries without creating duplicate accounts or duplicate welcome emails.
+
+Keep secrets and personal data out of logs, analytics, URLs, and response caches. Record the accepted terms version and consent date on the server. Serve the real Rewards Terms at `/rewards-terms` and Privacy Policy at `/privacy-policy` before launch. Provide verified email delivery and account recovery; the interface's confirmation copy assumes verification instructions are sent by the service.
+
+Configure HTTPS/HSTS and security headers at the hosting layer. The rewards behavior uses an external script and no inline event handlers; the existing page still has inline styles, so adopt a CSP compatible with those styles or externalize them first. The form deliberately uses minimal personal information and leaves marketing unchecked.

+# Rewards registration integration
+
+The static page implements a three-step, email-link enrollment form. No personal data is stored in browser storage, sent to third parties, or inserted as HTML. A successful enrollment is shown only after the API confirms `pending_verification`. The static server alone cannot enroll members; implement these same-origin endpoints before launch.
+
+## API contract
+
+- `GET /api/rewards/csrf`: return JSON `{ "csrfToken": "<session-bound token>" }` with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Issue a Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite session cookie over HTTPS.
+- `POST /api/rewards/register`: accept JSON with `givenName`, `familyName`, `email`, nullable `favoriteDrink`, nullable `birthday: { month, day }`, boolean `marketingConsent`, and boolean `termsAccepted`. Verify the `X-CSRF-Token` header against the session and verify the request Origin. Honor the `Idempotency-Key` header so retries cannot duplicate enrollment or email sends.
+- On acceptance, return HTTP 202 and `{ "status": "pending_verification" }`. Use the same response for existing and new eligible addresses to prevent account enumeration. Send a short-lived, single-use email verification link; activate rewards only after verification. Never return the link or its token to this client.
+- Use HTTP 429 for rate limits; other non-success responses produce a recoverable error. Responses must be JSON, not redirects. Never include submitted personal data in URLs, logs, or analytics.
+
+## Required server safeguards
+
+Client checks improve usability; repeat all checks on the server. Trim names, require nonempty names up to 80 characters, require a valid email up to 254 characters, reject unknown properties, and enforce input types and body size limits. Validate the drink against the displayed allowlist. Birthday must be absent or a valid month/day (including February 29). Require explicit terms acceptance. Keep marketing consent optional, default false, and record its timestamp and the applicable terms version. Enforce rate limits and replay protection; use parameterized persistence, least-privilege access, and a defined retention policy.
+
+Serve through HTTPS with HSTS and appropriate CSP, frame-ancestors, nosniff, and Referrer-Policy headers. A production CSP must account for this page's inline styles and Unsplash background images. The birthday gift and other advertised benefits must match the configured program.

+## Local checks
+
+No dev or preview server is needed. Run `node --check rewards.js` for JavaScript syntax. This project has no build script or backend dependencies.

+# The Daily Grind
+
+## Script performance monitoring
+
+The page automatically observes long animation frames (over 50 ms) in browsers
+that support the Long Animation Frames API. Buffered observation also captures
+available entries from before the monitor started. Each occurrence records its
+time, page URL, frame duration, blocking duration, and the source URLs and execution
+durations of contributing scripts. A script's presence identifies a contributor,
+not proof that it caused the entire delay. Browser restrictions may omit script
+attribution, especially for cross-origin scripts.
+
+The most recent 100 occurrences from the last seven days are retained in
+localStorage on this browser and origin, including across page reloads. URL query
+strings and fragments are removed. No records are sent to a server. If storage is
+unavailable, monitoring continues in memory. Unsupported browsers skip monitoring.
+
+Use the diagnostics API from application code or developer tools:
+
+```js
+dailyGrindPerformance.getStatus();      // Support, active observer, storage status
+dailyGrindPerformance.getHistory();     // Occurrences, oldest first; copied snapshot
+dailyGrindPerformance.getSlowScripts(); // Ranked by total execution time in history
+dailyGrindPerformance.clearHistory();   // Remove recorded and pending occurrences
+dailyGrindPerformance.stop();           // Flush pending entries and disconnect
+```
+
+Script summaries include execution count, total execution time, and maximum
+execution time in milliseconds, accumulated across all retained frames and visits.
+Frames without script attribution are still recorded in history.
+
+Run the isolated monitor tests with `npm test`. They use mocked performance entries
+and storage; no server or browser is required.

+# The Daily Grind: field INP monitoring
+
+The homepage loads the self-hosted `assets/inp-monitor.js` module. It uses
+`web-vitals/attribution` to measure real interactions throughout a visit, including
+page visibility changes and back/forward cache restores. No polling, synthetic
+interactions, or browser profiling is used. Visits without measurable interactions
+do not produce an INP value; unsupported browsers do not fabricate one.
+
+## Collector configuration
+
+The `inp-endpoint` meta tag in `index.html` defaults to `/analytics/inp`.
+**This repository is a static site and does not implement that endpoint.** Configure
+your production host to route POSTs at that path to your analytics collector, or
+change the meta tag to an existing collector. An empty content value disables
+monitoring. For a cross-origin collector, configure CORS for JSON POSTs and allow
+the collector through your CSP `connect-src` policy.
+
+The collector must accept JSON (one object per POST) and respond with a success
+status such as 204. Validate and rate-limit incoming reports. Store the latest
+snapshot per `id`, ordered by `reportedAt`: callbacks are updates to the page's INP,
+not separate interactions or visits. Do not sum `value` or average callback values.
+Compute the 75th percentile of each visit's latest `value`; good is <=200ms,
+needs-improvement is >200ms through 500ms, and poor is >500ms. All ratings are sent
+so the distribution includes fast visits as well as slow ones.
+
+Reports use native `fetchLater` where available. A newer snapshot replaces a
+pending snapshot of the same metric; back/forward cache visits have distinct IDs.
+The fallback queues until the document becomes hidden, then uses `sendBeacon`
+or `fetch` with `keepalive`. Reports produced while hidden are dispatched in a
+microtask. There are no unload handlers or persistent identifiers. Delivery is
+best effort; quota, CSP, offline, and collector failures are not retried.
+
+## Diagnosing a slow report
+
+- Compare `inputDelay`, `processingDuration`, and `presentationDelay` to find the
+  dominant phase. `interactionTarget` is a stable developer-authored link label,
+  with a tag-name fallback; it never includes clicked text or input values.
+- `longestScript` identifies the script URL, function, character position,
+  invoker type, intersecting duration, and the INP `subpart` it blocked. Source
+  URL queries/fragments are removed. Keep matching production source maps to
+  resolve minified function names and positions.
+- `forcedStyleDuration` and `forcedLayoutDuration` describe synchronous work
+  forced inside that script. `forcedStyleAndLayoutDuration` supplies the combined
+  fallback when the browser lacks the separate fields.
+- `renderStyleDuration` and `renderLayoutDuration` sum frame-level rendering
+  costs across all attributed frames. `totalStyleAndLayoutDuration` is the
+  library's combined fallback, including forced work. These are overlapping
+  diagnostics; do not add them together or assume whole-frame timings are
+  confined to the interaction's three phases.
+- `totalScriptDuration`, `totalPaintDuration`, and `totalUnattributedDuration`
+  provide the library's broader breakdown. `frames` contains timing boundaries
+  for up to five longest associated frames; `longAnimationFrameCount` counts all.
+
+Long Animation Frames attribution is optional. `loafSupported: false` means the
+browser lacks it; a supported browser can still have zero matching long frames.
+Missing measurements are `null`, not zero. INP and its three subparts remain
+available with Event Timing support. LoAF only reports sufficiently long frames
+and scripts, and has cross-origin attribution restrictions: the longest reported
+script is a diagnostic lead, not proof that every millisecond was caused by it.
+
+No full page URL, referrer, DOM content, cookies, or account identifiers are added
+to the payload. Same-origin requests can carry the browser's normal cookies;
+configure the collector's retention and handling as appropriate.
+
+## Build and automated checks
+
+```sh
+pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+pnpm test
+pnpm build
+```
+
+The generated bundle is committed so existing static hosting continues to work
+without a build step. Rebuild and commit it after changing `src/` or dependencies.
+Serve the HTML and `assets/` together; revalidate the bundle on deployment rather
+than applying immutable caching to its unversioned URL. Tests use synthetic
+performance entries and lifecycle events in Node; no browser or server is needed.

+# The Daily Grind — field INP monitoring
+
+The homepage loads the local `assets/inp.js` module, bundled from Google's
+`web-vitals/attribution` (locked in `pnpm-lock.yaml`). Its `onINP` implementation
+selects the page's INP candidate rather than treating every click as an INP,
+reports on visibility becoming hidden, continues after returning to the page,
+and handles back/forward cache restores. Unsupported browsers do not emit INP;
+visits without interactions do not count as zero-INP visits.
+
+## Collector setup
+
+This repository is a static site and does **not** contain a telemetry backend.
+Route `POST /api/vitals` to your analytics ingestion service before deployment,
+or change the `vitals-endpoint` meta tag in `index.html` to an existing collector.
+An empty endpoint disables monitoring. A same-origin endpoint is recommended;
+an external endpoint must accept JSON POSTs and configure CORS appropriately.
+Do not put collector credentials in the HTML.
+
+The client sends JSON via `sendBeacon`, falling back to `fetch` with `keepalive`.
+Delivery is best effort, with no blocking requests or retry loops. The collector
+should validate schema version 1, enforce a body size limit, and return 204.
+Upsert by `id` using the newest `reportedAt`: the same visit can emit an updated
+INP when a user returns from a hidden tab. Back/forward restoration gets a new
+metric ID. Do not sum `value` or count each report as a separate visit. Compute
+p75 of the latest INP per ID, segmented by page/navigation type. All supported
+interacted visits are reported, including good INP, to avoid a slow-only bias.
+
+## Reading a report
+
+- `value`, `rating`, `delta`, `id`, and `navigationType`: the library's INP metric
+  in milliseconds and its identity/lifecycle context.
+- `interaction`: stable developer-authored `data-inp-target` labels, input type,
+  relative timestamps, and document load state. No text, form values, arbitrary
+  DOM selectors, page URL, query strings, or fragments are included.
+- `phases`: input delay, processing duration, and presentation delay. Start with
+  the largest phase to locate the bottleneck.
+- For INP **over 200 ms**, `frames` includes up to five overlapping Long Animation
+  Frames with their blocking, render-start, and style/layout-start timings.
+  Each includes up to eight scripts, ranked by duration, filtered to overlap the
+  interaction. `frameCount`/`scriptCount` expose truncation. Script records contain
+  sanitized source URL, function, character position, invoker type, execution
+  timing, forced style/layout duration, and overlap with each INP phase.
+  `longestScript` includes the library's longest-script summary independently
+  of these caps. Use URL + function + character position to locate source code.
+- `rendering` contains the library's script, style/layout, paint, and unattributed
+  estimates. These are diagnostic estimates, not an exact CPU profiler; paint
+  delay includes off-main-thread work. Forced layout is already accounted for
+  in the style/layout total, so do not add it again. Frame timestamps describe
+  whole frames; individual script phase overlaps are clipped to the interaction.
+- `loafSupported` distinguishes API support from `attributionAvailable` (whether
+  this interaction has LoAF data). Missing timing values are `null`, not zero.
+  LoAF only exposes long frames and scripts above its reporting threshold;
+  cross-origin restrictions can hide script details. Correlation identifies
+  likely contributors, not guaranteed causation.
+
+See the upstream [INP attribution API](https://github.com/GoogleChrome/web-vitals#attribution)
+and [field diagnosis guide](https://web.dev/articles/find-slow-interactions-in-the-field).
+
+## Build and checks
+
+```sh
+pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+pnpm run build
+pnpm test
+```
+
+The generated bundle and its license notice are committed so the existing static
+hosting command can serve this homepage without a runtime build or CDN dependency.
+Rebuild after changing instrumentation. Tests exercise serialization of browser
+entries, phase overlap, missing APIs, data minimization, payload bounds, and
+beacon/fetch delivery. They do not use a browser or start a server.

+# Daily Grind passkey management
+
+`index.html` is the account view; `home.html` preserves the original storefront. No build step or dependencies are required. Run the non-browser checks with `npm test`.
+
+The supplied repository has no server, sessions, or WebAuthn registration. The default, visibly labeled **sample account** uses isolated localStorage data. It never calls an authenticator or changes real credentials. This is a working UI prototype, not a production authentication service.
+
+## Connect the customer backend
+
+Set `<meta name="passkey-data-source" content="api">` in `index.html` after implementing these same-origin endpoints:
+
+- `GET /api/account/passkeys`: the complete credential inventory for the authenticated customer.
+- `PATCH /api/account/passkeys/:id`: accept `{ "name": "Work laptop" }`; return the complete updated snapshot.
+- `DELETE /api/account/passkeys/:id`: revoke the key on the server before returning the complete updated snapshot.
+
+All three return JSON shaped like this (IDs shown are illustrative):
+
+```json
+{
+  "account": {
+    "displayName": "Jamie Lee",
+    "userId": "c2FtcGxlLWphbWll",
+    "rpId": "your-domain.example",
+    "canDeleteLastPasskey": false,
+    "csrfToken": "session-bound-csrf-token"
+  },
+  "passkeys": [{
+    "id": "server-record-id",
+    "credentialId": "d2ViYXV0aG4tY3JlZGVudGlhbC1pZA",
+    "name": "MacBook Pro",
+    "device": "laptop",
+    "createdAt": "2026-09-12T09:00:00Z",
+    "lastUsedAt": "2026-11-19T08:42:00Z",
+    "current": true
+  }]
+}
+```
+
+`userId` must be the exact base64url WebAuthn user handle used at registration; `credentialId` must be the actual base64url credential ID, not the database record ID. `rpId` must match the registration RP. Return the **entire** list, never a filtered or paginated subset: authenticator signals may hide omitted credentials. `lastUsedAt` may be null. `device` supports `laptop`, `phone`, `usb`, with a generic key fallback. Derive `current` from the authenticated session; do not infer it from the browser user agent.
+
+The server must authenticate and authorize every request, scope credential IDs to that customer, validate names, validate the `X-CSRF-Token` header and request origin on mutations, and prevent deletion of the last sign-in method in a transaction. Set `canDeleteLastPasskey` true only when an alternate sign-in method is available. Use HTTPS, secure session cookies, and `Cache-Control: no-store` for these responses. Return 401 for expired sessions, 403 for unauthorized changes, and 409 for stale records or last-method protection. The client never treats a failed API request as a sample session.
+
+## Authenticator synchronization
+
+After loading a complete authenticated snapshot and after confirmed deletion, the client requests `PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials`. Calls are serialized so newer snapshots are sent last. Older browsers with `signalUnknownCredential` receive a targeted deletion signal instead. Unsupported browsers and failed signals receive manual password-manager guidance. Browser acceptance of a signal is reported as an update **request**, not proof that every device has updated. Reloading an account retries full synchronization.
+
+Renaming changes only the site's passkey label. `signalCurrentUserDetails` updates the account identity, not individual key labels, so it is deliberately not called on rename. Other-device and provider-managed labels may differ.
+
+See the [WebAuthn specification](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-webauthn-4-20260915/#sctn-signalAllAcceptedCredentials) for the authenticated full-list signal contract.
+
+No dev/preview servers or browser verification were used.

+import { createRepository, normalizeName, syncAuthenticator } from './passkeys.mjs';
+
+const $ = selector => document.querySelector(selector);
+const mode = $('meta[name="passkey-data-source"]').content;
+let storage;
+try { storage = window.localStorage; } catch { /* Provide read-only sample if blocked. */ }
+const repository = createRepository({ mode, storage });
+const list = $('#passkey-list');
+const dialog = $('#key-dialog');
+const form = $('#key-form');
+const input = $('#key-name');
+const confirm = $('#confirm-button');
+let snapshot;
+let activeKey;
+let action;
+let busy = false;
+let opener;
+let requestVersion = 0;
+let syncQueue = Promise.resolve();
+function queueSync(data, removedCredentialId) {
+  // Serialize signals so an older snapshot cannot arrive after a newer one.
+  syncQueue = syncQueue.then(() => syncAuthenticator(data, { mode, removedCredentialId }));
+  return syncQueue;
+}
+
+function el(tag, className, content) {
+  const node = document.createElement(tag);
+  if (className) node.className = className;
+  if (content !== undefined) node.textContent = content;
+  return node;
+}
+function icon(name, className = '') {
+  const node = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
+  const use = document.createElementNS(node.namespaceURI, 'use');
+  use.setAttribute('href', `#${name}`);
+  node.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
+  if (className) node.setAttribute('class', className);
+  node.append(use);
+  return node;
+}
+function announce(message, type = '') {
+  const status = $('#status');
+  status.textContent = message;
+  status.className = `status ${type}`;
+  status.hidden = !message;
+}
+function formatDate(value) {
+  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' }).format(new Date(value));
+}
+function render() {
+  $('#key-count').textContent = snapshot.passkeys.length;
+  $('#customer-name').textContent = snapshot.account.displayName;
+  $('#avatar').textContent = snapshot.account.displayName.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).map(part => part[0]).join('').toUpperCase();
+  list.replaceChildren();
+  list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+  if (!snapshot.passkeys.length) {
+    const empty = el('div', 'empty-state');
+    empty.append(icon('key'), el('strong', '', 'No passkeys registered'), el('p', '', 'You can still sign in using your other account sign-in method.'));
+    list.append(empty);
+    return;
+  }
+  for (const key of snapshot.passkeys) {
+    const row = el('div', 'passkey-row');
+    const device = el('div', 'device-icon');
+    device.append(icon(['laptop', 'phone', 'usb'].includes(key.device) ? key.device : 'key'));
+    const details = el('div', 'key-details');
+    const title = el('div', 'key-title');
+    title.append(el('h4', '', key.name));
+    if (key.current) title.append(el('span', 'current-badge', 'This device'));
+    const meta = el('div', 'key-meta');
+    meta.append(el('span', '', `Added ${formatDate(key.createdAt)}`), el('span', 'dot', '·'), el('span', '', key.lastUsedAt ? `Last used ${formatDate(key.lastUsedAt)}` : 'Not used yet'));
+    details.append(title, meta);
+    const actions = el('div', 'row-actions');
+    for (const [type, symbol] of [['rename', 'edit'], ['delete', 'trash']]) {
+      const button = el('button', `icon-button ${type}`);
+      button.type = 'button';
+      button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${type === 'rename' ? 'Rename' : 'Delete'} ${key.name}`);
+      button.title = `${type === 'rename' ? 'Rename' : 'Delete'} passkey`;
+      button.dataset.keyId = key.id;
+      button.dataset.action = type;
+      button.append(icon(symbol));
+      button.addEventListener('click', () => openDialog(key, type, button));
+      actions.append(button);
+    }
+    row.append(device, details, actions);
+    list.append(row);
+  }
+}
+function openDialog(key, type, button) {
+  activeKey = key;
+  action = type;
+  opener = button;
+  const deleting = type === 'delete';
+  const blocked = deleting && snapshot.passkeys.length === 1 && !snapshot.account.canDeleteLastPasskey;
+  $('#dialog-title').textContent = deleting ? 'Delete this passkey?' : 'Rename passkey';
+  $('#dialog-description').textContent = deleting
+    ? `“${key.name}” will no longer be able to sign in to your Daily Grind account. This can’t be undone.`
+    : 'Give this passkey a name that makes it easy to recognize.';
+  $('#dialog-icon use').setAttribute('href', deleting ? '#trash' : '#edit');
+  $('#rename-fields').hidden = deleting;
+  input.disabled = deleting;
+  input.value = key.name;
+  input.setCustomValidity('');
+  $('#delete-warning').hidden = !deleting;
+  $('#delete-warning').textContent = blocked
+    ? 'This is your last sign-in method. Set up another way to sign in before removing this passkey.'
+    : mode === 'demo'
+      ? 'This is a sample passkey. Deleting it only changes the sample account in this browser.'
+      : key.current
+        ? 'You’re using this passkey on this device. Have another way to sign in before deleting it. We’ll also ask your browser to update your authenticator.'
+        : 'We’ll also ask your browser to update your authenticator. You may need to remove this passkey from other devices manually.';
+  confirm.textContent = deleting ? 'Delete passkey' : 'Save name';
+  confirm.className = `button ${deleting ? 'danger-button' : 'primary'}`;
+  confirm.disabled = blocked;
+  $('#dialog-error').hidden = true;
+  dialog.showModal();
+  if (deleting) dialog.querySelector('.dialog-actions .close-button').focus();
+  else { input.focus(); input.select(); }
+}
+function closeDialog() {
+  if (!busy) dialog.close();
+}
+for (const button of document.querySelectorAll('.close-button')) button.addEventListener('click', closeDialog);
+dialog.addEventListener('cancel', event => { if (busy) event.preventDefault(); });
+dialog.addEventListener('click', event => { if (event.target === dialog && event.clientX !== 0) {
+  const bounds = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
+  if (event.clientX < bounds.left || event.clientX > bounds.right || event.clientY < bounds.top || event.clientY > bounds.bottom) closeDialog();
+} });
+dialog.addEventListener('close', () => {
+  const replacement = [...list.querySelectorAll('button')].find(button => button.dataset.keyId === activeKey?.id && button.dataset.action === action);
+  (opener?.isConnected ? opener : replacement || list.querySelector('button') || $('#registered-title')).focus();
+});
+$('#registered-title').tabIndex = -1;
+input.addEventListener('input', () => input.setCustomValidity(''));
+
+function showSyncResult(result) {
+  const messages = {
+    demo: 'Sample account · Changes are saved only in this browser.',
+    requested: 'Browser update requested. Other devices may need a manual update.',
+    unsupported: 'Automatic sync isn’t supported here. Manage removed keys in your device’s password manager.',
+    failed: 'Browser sync couldn’t finish. Remove deleted keys from your device’s password manager.'
+  };
+  $('#sync-status').textContent = messages[result];
+}
+
+form.addEventListener('submit', async event => {
+  event.preventDefault();
+  if (busy || confirm.disabled) return;
+  if (action === 'rename') {
+    try { input.value = normalizeName(input.value); }
+    catch (error) { input.setCustomValidity(error.message); input.reportValidity(); return; }
+  }
+  busy = true;
+  confirm.disabled = true;
+  confirm.textContent = action === 'delete' ? 'Deleting…' : 'Saving…';
+  for (const button of dialog.querySelectorAll('.close-button')) button.disabled = true;
+  input.disabled = true;
+  $('#dialog-error').hidden = true;
+  const key = activeKey;
+  const removing = action === 'delete';
+  let saved = false;
+  try {
+    snapshot = removing ? await repository.remove(key.id) : await repository.rename(key.id, input.value);
+    render();
+    busy = false;
+    dialog.close();
+    saved = true;
+    ++requestVersion;
+    announce(removing ? `“${key.name}” was deleted${mode === 'demo' ? ' from this sample account' : ''}.` : 'Passkey name updated.');
+  } catch (error) {
+    $('#dialog-error').textContent = error instanceof TypeError ? 'We couldn’t save your change. Check your connection and try again.' : error.message;
+    $('#dialog-error').hidden = false;
+  } finally {
+    busy = false;
+    confirm.disabled = false;
+    confirm.textContent = action === 'delete' ? 'Delete passkey' : 'Save name';
+    for (const button of dialog.querySelectorAll('.close-button')) button.disabled = false;
+    input.disabled = action === 'delete';
+  }
+  if (saved && removing) {
+    const version = ++requestVersion;
+    const result = await queueSync(snapshot, key.credentialId);
+    if (version !== requestVersion) return;
+    showSyncResult(result);
+    if (result === 'unsupported' || result === 'failed') {
+      announce(`“${key.name}” was deleted from your account. Remove it from your device’s password manager manually.`, 'warning');
+    }
+  }
+
+});
+
+async function load() {
+  list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
+  announce('');
+  try {
+    snapshot = await repository.load();
+    render();
+    const version = ++requestVersion;
+    const result = await queueSync(snapshot);
+    if (version === requestVersion) showSyncResult(result);
+  } catch (error) {
+    list.setAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');
+    $('#key-count').textContent = '—';
+    const empty = el('div', 'empty-state');
+    empty.append(el('strong', '', 'Your passkeys couldn’t be loaded'), el('p', '', 'Please try again in a moment.'));
+    const retry = el('button', 'button secondary', 'Try again');
+    retry.addEventListener('click', () => { retry.disabled = true; load(); });
+    empty.append(retry);
+    list.replaceChildren(empty);
+    announce(error.message, 'error');
+  }
+}
+if (mode !== 'demo') {
+  $('#demo-label').hidden = true;
+  $('#customer-name').textContent = 'Your account';
+  $('#avatar').textContent = 'DG';
+  $('#customer-detail').textContent = 'Account settings';
+  $('#sync-status').textContent = 'Checking browser sync support…';
+}
+load();

+// Backend contract and integration notes are documented in PASSKEYS.md.
+export function normalizeName(value) {
+  const name = String(value).trim();
+  if (!name || name.length > 60 || /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(name)) {
+    throw new Error('Use a name between 1 and 60 characters, without control characters.');
+  }
+  return name;
+}
+
+export function validateSnapshot(data) {
+  const account = data?.account;
+  const base64url = /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/;
+  if (!account || typeof account.displayName !== 'string' || !account.displayName.trim() ||
+      typeof account.userId !== 'string' || !base64url.test(account.userId) ||
+      typeof account.rpId !== 'string' || !account.rpId ||
+      typeof account.canDeleteLastPasskey !== 'boolean' ||
+      !Array.isArray(data.passkeys)) throw new Error('The account response is incomplete. Please try again.');
+  const seen = new Set();
+  const credentials = new Set();
+  for (const key of data.passkeys) {
+    if (!key || typeof key.id !== 'string' || !key.id || seen.has(key.id) ||
+        typeof key.credentialId !== 'string' || !base64url.test(key.credentialId) || credentials.has(key.credentialId) ||
+        typeof key.name !== 'string' || !key.name.trim() || typeof key.device !== 'string' ||
+        !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(key.createdAt)) ||
+        (key.lastUsedAt !== null && !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(key.lastUsedAt))) ||
+        typeof key.current !== 'boolean') throw new Error('The passkey response is incomplete. Please try again.');
+    seen.add(key.id);
+    credentials.add(key.credentialId);
+  }
+  return data;
+}
+
+const sample = {
+  account: { displayName: 'Jamie Lee', userId: 'c2FtcGxlLWphbWll', rpId: 'example.invalid', canDeleteLastPasskey: false },
+  passkeys: [
+    { id: 'sample-mac', credentialId: 'c2FtcGxlLW1hYw', name: 'MacBook Pro', device: 'laptop', createdAt: '2026-09-12T09:00:00Z', lastUsedAt: '2026-11-19T08:42:00Z', current: true },
+    { id: 'sample-iphone', credentialId: 'c2FtcGxlLWlwaG9uZQ', name: 'iPhone 15', device: 'phone', createdAt: '2026-09-12T09:05:00Z', lastUsedAt: '2026-11-17T10:20:00Z', current: false },
+    { id: 'sample-security-key', credentialId: 'c2FtcGxlLXNlY3VyaXR5', name: 'YubiKey 5', device: 'usb', createdAt: '2026-10-03T11:30:00Z', lastUsedAt: '2026-11-02T12:15:00Z', current: false }
+  ]
+};
+const storageKey = 'daily-grind.sample-passkeys.v1';
+
+export function createRepository({ mode, storage, fetcher = globalThis.fetch }) {
+  if (mode !== 'demo' && mode !== 'api') throw new Error('Account data source is not configured.');
+  let snapshot;
+  async function request(path = '', options = {}) {
+    const headers = { Accept: 'application/json' };
+    if (options.method) {
+      if (!snapshot?.account.csrfToken) throw new Error('Your security token is missing. Reload your account and try again.');
+      headers['X-CSRF-Token'] = snapshot.account.csrfToken;
+      if (options.body) headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
+    }
+    const response = await fetcher(`/api/account/passkeys${path}`, {
+      ...options, headers, credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store', redirect: 'error'
+    });
+    if (!response.ok) {
+      if (response.status === 401) throw new Error('Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage your passkeys.');
+      if (response.status === 403) throw new Error('This change was not authorized. Reload your account and try again.');
+      if (response.status === 409) throw new Error('Your passkeys have changed, or this is your last sign-in method. Refresh the list before trying again.');
+      throw new Error('We couldn’t update your passkeys. Please try again.');
+    }
+    return validateSnapshot(await response.json());
+  }
+  function saveSample(next) {
+    // Persist first: a blocked/full storage must never appear to save successfully.
+    if (!storage) throw new Error('Browser storage is unavailable. Allow site storage to edit this sample account.');
+    storage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(next));
+    return next;
+  }
+  return {
+    mode,
+    async load() {
+      if (mode === 'api') snapshot = await request();
+      else {
+        let saved;
+        try { saved = storage?.getItem(storageKey); } catch { /* Read-only sample remains usable. */ }
+        if (saved) {
+          try { snapshot = validateSnapshot(JSON.parse(saved)); }
+          catch { snapshot = structuredClone(sample); }
+        } else snapshot = structuredClone(sample);
+      }
+      return structuredClone(snapshot);
+    },
+    async rename(id, value) {
+      const name = normalizeName(value);
+      if (!snapshot?.passkeys.some(key => key.id === id)) throw new Error('This passkey is no longer available. Refresh the list.');
+      if (mode === 'api') snapshot = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: JSON.stringify({ name }) });
+      else snapshot = saveSample({ ...snapshot, passkeys: snapshot.passkeys.map(key => key.id === id ? { ...key, name } : key) });
+      return structuredClone(snapshot);
+    },
+    async remove(id) {
+      if (!snapshot?.passkeys.some(key => key.id === id)) throw new Error('This passkey is no longer available. Refresh the list.');
+      if (snapshot.passkeys.length === 1 && !snapshot.account.canDeleteLastPasskey) {
+        throw new Error('This is your last sign-in method. Set up another way to sign in before deleting it.');
+      }
+      if (mode === 'api') snapshot = await request(`/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
+      else snapshot = saveSample({ ...snapshot, passkeys: snapshot.passkeys.filter(key => key.id !== id) });
+      return structuredClone(snapshot);
+    }
+  };
+}
+
+// Passkey labels are RP-local metadata. signalCurrentUserDetails changes the
+// account's user/display name, so it must NOT be used when renaming a key.
+export async function syncAuthenticator(snapshot, { mode, removedCredentialId, credentialAPI = globalThis.PublicKeyCredential } = {}) {
+  if (mode === 'demo') return 'demo';
+  if (!credentialAPI) return 'unsupported';
+  try {
+    if (typeof credentialAPI.signalAllAcceptedCredentials === 'function') {
+      await credentialAPI.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({
+        rpId: snapshot.account.rpId,
+        userId: snapshot.account.userId,
+        allAcceptedCredentialIds: snapshot.passkeys.map(key => key.credentialId)
+      });
+      return 'requested';
+    }
+    if (removedCredentialId && typeof credentialAPI.signalUnknownCredential === 'function') {
+      await credentialAPI.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId: snapshot.account.rpId, credentialId: removedCredentialId });
+      return 'requested';
+    }
+    return 'unsupported';
+  } catch {
+    // Server deletion has already succeeded; a signal failure cannot undo it.
+    return 'failed';
+  }
+}

index 0000000..ffcefb4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/passkeys.test.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,134 @@
+import test from 'node:test';
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { createRepository, normalizeName, syncAuthenticator, validateSnapshot } from '../passkeys.mjs';
+
+function memoryStorage() {
+  const values = new Map();
+  return { getItem: key => values.get(key), setItem: (key, value) => values.set(key, value) };
+}
+async function sample() {
+  return createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage: memoryStorage() }).load();
+}
+
+test('sample edits persist across reloads and return defensive copies', async () => {
+  const storage = memoryStorage();
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage });
+  const data = await repo.load();
+  const renamed = await repo.rename(data.passkeys[0].id, '  Work laptop  ');
+  renamed.passkeys[0].name = 'External change';
+  const reloaded = await createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage }).load();
+  assert.equal(reloaded.passkeys[0].name, 'Work laptop');
+  await repo.remove(data.passkeys[1].id);
+  assert.equal((await repo.load()).passkeys.length, 2);
+});
+
+test('names reject empty, oversized and control characters', () => {
+  for (const name of ['', '   ', 'x'.repeat(61), 'Key\nName']) assert.throws(() => normalizeName(name));
+  assert.equal(normalizeName(' My phone '), 'My phone');
+});
+
+test('last sign-in method cannot be deleted', async () => {
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage: memoryStorage() });
+  const data = await repo.load();
+  await repo.remove(data.passkeys[0].id);
+  await repo.remove(data.passkeys[1].id);
+  await assert.rejects(repo.remove(data.passkeys[2].id), /last sign-in method/);
+  assert.equal((await repo.load()).passkeys.length, 1);
+});
+
+test('blocked storage does not commit an edit', async () => {
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage: { getItem: () => null, setItem: () => { throw new Error('Storage blocked'); } } });
+  const data = await repo.load();
+  await assert.rejects(repo.rename(data.passkeys[0].id, 'Changed'), /Storage blocked/);
+  assert.equal((await repo.load()).passkeys[0].name, 'MacBook Pro');
+});
+
+test('API uses authenticated requests with CSRF and encoded IDs', async () => {
+  const data = await sample();
+  data.account.csrfToken = 'csrf-test-token';
+  data.passkeys[0].id = 'key/with space';
+  const calls = [];
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'api', fetcher: async (url, options) => {
+    calls.push({ url, options });
+    const next = structuredClone(data);
+    if (options.method === 'PATCH') next.passkeys[0].name = JSON.parse(options.body).name;
+    if (options.method === 'DELETE') next.passkeys.splice(0, 1);
+    return { ok: true, json: async () => next };
+  } });
+  await repo.load();
+  await repo.rename('key/with space', 'My Mac');
+  await repo.remove('key/with space');
+  assert.equal(calls[1].url, '/api/account/passkeys/key%2Fwith%20space');
+  assert.equal(calls[1].options.headers['X-CSRF-Token'], 'csrf-test-token');
+  assert.equal(calls[1].options.credentials, 'same-origin');
+  assert.equal(calls[1].options.cache, 'no-store');
+  assert.equal(calls[2].options.method, 'DELETE');
+});
+
+test('failed server deletion never triggers an authenticator signal', async () => {
+  const data = await sample();
+  data.account.csrfToken = 'token';
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'api', fetcher: async (_, options) => options.method
+    ? { ok: false, status: 500 }
+    : { ok: true, json: async () => data } });
+  await repo.load();
+  let signaled = false;
+  try {
+    const updated = await repo.remove(data.passkeys[0].id);
+    await syncAuthenticator(updated, { mode: 'api', credentialAPI: { signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async () => { signaled = true; } } });
+    assert.fail('Deletion should fail');
+  } catch (error) { assert.match(error.message, /couldn’t update/); }
+  assert.equal(signaled, false);
+});
+
+test('successful deletion signals only the remaining authoritative credential IDs', async () => {
+  const data = await sample();
+  const remaining = { ...data, passkeys: data.passkeys.slice(1) };
+  let signaled;
+  const result = await syncAuthenticator(remaining, { mode: 'api', credentialAPI: {
+    signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async value => { signaled = value; }
+  } });
+  assert.equal(result, 'requested');
+  assert.deepEqual(signaled, { rpId: data.account.rpId, userId: data.account.userId, allAcceptedCredentialIds: remaining.passkeys.map(key => key.credentialId) });
+});
+
+test('sample accounts never signal a real authenticator', async () => {
+  let called = false;
+  assert.equal(await syncAuthenticator(await sample(), { mode: 'demo', credentialAPI: {
+    signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async () => { called = true; }
+  } }), 'demo');
+  assert.equal(called, false);
+});
+
+test('browser signal failure preserves successful account deletion and allows retry', async () => {
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'demo', storage: memoryStorage() });
+  const data = await repo.load();
+  const updated = await repo.remove(data.passkeys[0].id);
+  assert.equal(await syncAuthenticator(updated, { mode: 'api', credentialAPI: {
+    signalAllAcceptedCredentials: async () => { throw new Error('Not supported by provider'); }
+  } }), 'failed');
+  assert.equal((await repo.load()).passkeys.length, 2);
+});
+
+test('older browsers use the targeted deletion signal or show manual guidance', async () => {
+  const data = await sample();
+  let signaled;
+  const result = await syncAuthenticator(data, { mode: 'api', removedCredentialId: 'cmVtb3ZlZA', credentialAPI: {
+    signalUnknownCredential: async value => { signaled = value; }
+  } });
+  assert.equal(result, 'requested');
+  assert.deepEqual(signaled, { rpId: data.account.rpId, credentialId: 'cmVtb3ZlZA' });
+  assert.equal(await syncAuthenticator(data, { mode: 'api', credentialAPI: {} }), 'unsupported');
+});
+
+test('session expiry is explicit; API failures never fall back to sample data', async () => {
+  const repo = createRepository({ mode: 'api', fetcher: async () => ({ ok: false, status: 401 }) });
+  await assert.rejects(repo.load(), /session has expired/);
+});
+
+test('incomplete or duplicate snapshots cannot be used for a full authenticator signal', async () => {
+  const data = await sample();
+  assert.throws(() => validateSnapshot({ account: data.account }), /incomplete/);
+  assert.throws(() => validateSnapshot({ ...data, passkeys: [data.passkeys[0], data.passkeys[0]] }), /incomplete/);
+  assert.doesNotThrow(() => validateSnapshot({ ...data, passkeys: [] }));
+});

@@ -15,3 +15,40 @@ The application will now be running on `http://localhost:11224`.
 - **[React](https://react.dev/)**: Used for UI components.
 - **[Tailwind CSS](https://tailwindcss.com/)**: For styling the application.
 - **[Astro DB](https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/database/)**: Powers the comments feature, using a libSQL-compatible database.
+
+## Passkeys and account settings
+
+Sign-in supports a passkey button and passkeys in username autofill, with the existing
+password service as a fallback. After sign-up, readers can create a passkey or continue
+to **My account** → **Account settings**. Settings support creation, renaming, removal,
+and display-name updates; changes require a passkey or password verification.
+
+The same-origin `/api/auth/*` routes verify passwords with the existing remote identity
+service and establish an HttpOnly Astro session. WebAuthn signatures are verified with
+SimpleWebAuthn on the server; no passwords or private keys are stored locally. Passkeys
+are linked to the exact username verified by the identity service. Existing password
+accounts must sign in once before adding a passkey. Account usernames remain managed
+by the identity service; local display-name updates do not rename login identities.
+
+Deployment requirements:
+
+- Node.js 22.13+ (uses built-in SQLite), HTTPS in production; localhost works over HTTP.
+- Set `WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN` to the exact public origin, e.g. `https://example.com` (no path).
+  It defaults to Astro's configured `site` origin; local development uses the localhost
+  request origin. Set `WEBAUTHN_RP_ID` only if using a shared parent domain; otherwise
+  it defaults to the configured origin's hostname. Keep both stable after enrollment.
+- `PASSKEY_DATABASE_PATH` defaults to `.data/accounts.sqlite`. Mount durable storage
+  there and persist Astro's filesystem session storage. The bundled SQLite and session
+  setup supports a single application instance; multiple replicas need shared account
+  and session storage before deployment. Losing the account store invalidates passkeys;
+  password sign-in remains available.
+- Sessions last 24 hours. Challenges expire after 5 minutes and are single-use. Sensitive
+  endpoints require verification within the last 5 minutes; the settings UI explicitly
+  asks for verification before each change. Reauthentication is restricted to the
+  signed-in account's credentials and requires user verification.
+
+Browser JSON helpers and capability checks use `webauthn-polyfills`; Signal APIs are
+feature-detected and non-fatal. Provider names and compact icons in
+`public/passkey-providers.json` come from the community
+[passkey authenticator AAGUID registry](https://github.com/passkeydeveloper/passkey-authenticator-aaguids).
+AAGUIDs are used only for display hints, never for access decisions.

'username' : 'username webauthn'} autoFocus={!signup} aria-describedby="auth-description" autoCapitalize="none" spellCheck={false} required maxLength={80} value={username} onChange={e => setUsername(e.target.value)} disabled={busy} /></div>

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/lib/auth-client.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,77 @@
+export const accountUrl = `${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}account/settings`;
+export class ApiError extends Error { constructor(public status: number, message: string) { super(message); } }
+export async function api<T = any>(path: string, data?: unknown): Promise<T> {
+  const response = await fetch(`${import.meta.env.BASE_URL}api/auth/${path}`, {
+    method: data === undefined ? 'GET' : 'POST', credentials: 'same-origin', cache: 'no-store',
+    headers: data === undefined ? {} : { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    body: data === undefined ? undefined : JSON.stringify(data),
+  });
+  const result = await response.json();
+  if (!response.ok) throw new ApiError(response.status, result.error || 'Please try again.');
+  return result;
+}
+export async function capabilities() {
+  if (!window.isSecureContext || !window.PublicKeyCredential) return null;
+  try {
+    await import('webauthn-polyfills');
+    return await PublicKeyCredential.getClientCapabilities();
+  } catch { return null; }
+}
+async function signalUnknown(rpId: string, credentialId: string) {
+  if (!PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential) return;
+  try { await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({ rpId, credentialId }); }
+  catch (error) { console.warn('Passkey sync unavailable:', error); }
+}
+export async function authenticate(reauth = false, conditional = false, signal?: AbortSignal) {
+  const path = reauth ? 'reauthentication' : 'authentication';
+  const options = await api(`${path}/options`, {});
+  signal?.throwIfAborted();
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(options);
+  const credential = await navigator.credentials.get({ publicKey, signal, ...(conditional ? { mediation: 'conditional' as const } : {}) }) as PublicKeyCredential | null;
+  if (!credential) throw new Error('No passkey selected. Please try again.');
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  try { return await api(`${path}/verify`, encoded); }
+  catch (error) {
+    if (!reauth && error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404) await signalUnknown(options.rpId, encoded.id);
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+export async function registerPasskey() {
+  const options = await api('registration/options', {});
+  const publicKey = PublicKeyCredential.parseCreationOptionsFromJSON(options);
+  const credential = await navigator.credentials.create({ publicKey }) as PublicKeyCredential | null;
+  if (!credential) throw new Error('No passkey created. Please try again.');
+  const encoded = credential.toJSON();
+  try { return await api('registration/verify', encoded); }
+  catch (error) { await signalUnknown(options.rp.id, encoded.id); throw error; }
+}
+export function errorMessage(error: unknown): string {
+  if (error instanceof DOMException) {
+    if (error.name === 'NotAllowedError') return 'The passkey request was cancelled or timed out. You can try again or use your password.';
+    if (error.name === 'InvalidStateError') return 'A passkey already exists in this password manager. Try another device or security key.';
+    if (error.name === 'SecurityError') return 'Passkeys require HTTPS and a correctly configured site domain.';
+    if (error.name === 'AbortError') return 'The passkey request was cancelled. Please try again.';
+  }
+  return error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong. Please try again.';
+}
+export interface CredentialSummary {
+  id: string; name: string; aaguid: string; deviceType: string; backedUp: boolean;
+  registeredAt: number; lastUsedAt: number | null;
+}
+export interface AccountSummary {
+  user: { id: string; username: string; displayName: string };
+  rpId: string; credentials: CredentialSummary[];
+}
+const validId = (value: string) => /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/.test(value) && value.length % 4 !== 1;
+export async function syncCredentials(account: AccountSummary) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalAllAcceptedCredentials) return;
+  const ids = account.credentials.map(key => key.id);
+  if (!validId(account.user.id) || !ids.every(validId)) return;
+  try { await PublicKeyCredential.signalAllAcceptedCredentials({ rpId: account.rpId, userId: account.user.id, allAcceptedCredentialIds: ids }); }
+  catch (error) { console.warn('Passkey sync unavailable:', error); }
+}
+export async function syncProfile(account: AccountSummary) {
+  if (!window.PublicKeyCredential?.signalCurrentUserDetails || !validId(account.user.id)) return;
+  try { await PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails({ rpId: account.rpId, userId: account.user.id, name: account.user.username, displayName: account.user.displayName }); }
+  catch (error) { console.warn('Passkey profile sync unavailable:', error); }
+}

+import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite';
+import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
+
+export interface Account { id: string; username: string; displayName: string }
+export interface Passkey {
+  id: string; userId: string; publicKey: string; counter: number; transports: string[];
+  name: string; aaguid: string; deviceType: string; backedUp: boolean;
+  registeredAt: number; lastUsedAt: number | null;
+}
+let database: DatabaseSync;
+function db() {
+  if (!database) {
+    const path = resolve(process.env.PASSKEY_DATABASE_PATH || '.data/accounts.sqlite');
+    mkdirSync(dirname(path), { recursive: true });
+    database = new DatabaseSync(path);
+    database.exec(`PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL; PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
+      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS accounts (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL, displayName TEXT NOT NULL);
+      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS passkeys (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, userId TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id), data TEXT NOT NULL);
+      CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS challenges (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expires INTEGER NOT NULL);`);
+  }
+  return database;
+}
+export function accountById(id: string): Account | undefined {
+  return db().prepare('SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id=?').get(id) as unknown as Account | undefined;
+}
+export function accountForUsername(username: string): Account {
+  // Only called after the existing identity service has verified the username/password.
+  db().prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO accounts VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'), username, username);
+  return db().prepare('SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE username=?').get(username) as unknown as Account;
+}
+export function updateDisplayName(id: string, name: string) {
+  db().prepare('UPDATE accounts SET displayName=? WHERE id=?').run(name, id);
+}
+export function passkeysFor(userId: string): Passkey[] {
+  return db().prepare('SELECT data FROM passkeys WHERE userId=?').all(userId).map(row => JSON.parse(row.data as string));
+}
+export function passkeyById(id: string): Passkey | undefined {
+  const row = db().prepare('SELECT data FROM passkeys WHERE id=?').get(id);
+  return row ? JSON.parse(row.data as string) : undefined;
+}
+export function insertPasskey(key: Passkey) {
+  db().prepare('INSERT INTO passkeys VALUES (?, ?, ?)').run(key.id, key.userId, JSON.stringify(key));
+}
+export function updatePasskey(key: Passkey) {
+  db().prepare('UPDATE passkeys SET data=? WHERE id=? AND userId=?').run(JSON.stringify(key), key.id, key.userId);
+}
+export function deletePasskey(id: string, userId: string) {
+  db().prepare('DELETE FROM passkeys WHERE id=? AND userId=?').run(id, userId);
+}
+export function consumeChallenge(id: string, expires: number) {
+  // Unique insert makes challenges single-use even across simultaneous requests.
+  db().prepare('DELETE FROM challenges WHERE expires < ?').run(Date.now());
+  return db().prepare('INSERT OR IGNORE INTO challenges VALUES (?, ?)').run(id, expires).changes === 1;
+}

diff --git a/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts b/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts
