index 0000000..5d04416
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/pages/api/auth/[...action].ts
@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+import type { APIRoute, APIContext } from 'astro';
+import { generateRegistrationOptions, verifyRegistrationResponse, generateAuthenticationOptions, verifyAuthenticationResponse } from '@simplewebauthn/server';
+import { accountById, accountForUsername, updateDisplayName, passkeysFor, passkeyById, insertPasskey, updatePasskey, deletePasskey, consumeChallenge, type Account } from '../../../lib/server/accounts';
+
+const IDENTITY_API = 'https://us-central1-web-devrel-apps.cloudfunctions.net/times_cdn/api';
+const SESSION_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
+const RECENT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
+interface Challenge { value: string; purpose: string; userId?: string; expires: number; requireUV: boolean }
+class AuthError extends Error { constructor(public status: number, message: string) { super(message); } }
+const json = (data: unknown, status = 200) => new Response(JSON.stringify(data), { status, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' } });
+function configuration(context: APIContext) {
+  const requested = new URL(context.request.url);
+  const configured = process.env.WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN || context.site?.origin;
+  const local = requested.hostname === 'localhost' || requested.hostname === '127.0.0.1';
+  const origin = local && !process.env.WEBAUTHN_ORIGIN ? requested.origin : configured;
+  if (!origin || requested.origin !== origin) throw new AuthError(403, 'This origin is not configured for passkeys.');
+  return { origin, rpID: process.env.WEBAUTHN_RP_ID || new URL(origin).hostname };
+}
+async function signedIn(context: APIContext): Promise<Account> {
+  const auth = await context.session!.get<{ userId: string; expires: number }>('auth');
+  const user = auth && auth.expires > Date.now() ? accountById(auth.userId) : undefined;
+  if (!user) throw new AuthError(401, 'Sign in to manage your account.');
+  return user;
+}
+async function requireRecent(context: APIContext) {
+  const verified = await context.session!.get<number>('verifiedAt');
+  if (!verified || Date.now() - verified > RECENT_MS) throw new AuthError(403, 'Verify your identity before making this change.');
+}
+async function establishSession(context: APIContext, user: Account) {
+  await context.session!.regenerate();
+  context.session!.delete('challenge');
+  context.session!.set('auth', { userId: user.id, expires: Date.now() + SESSION_MS });
+  context.session!.set('verifiedAt', Date.now());
+}
+async function takeChallenge(context: APIContext, purpose: string, userId?: string) {
+  const challenge = await context.session!.get<Challenge>('challenge');
+  context.session!.delete('challenge');
+  if (!challenge || challenge.purpose !== purpose || challenge.userId !== userId || challenge.expires < Date.now() || !consumeChallenge(challenge.value, challenge.expires)) {
+    throw new AuthError(400, 'This request expired or was already used. Please try again.');
+  }
+  return challenge;
+}
+async function body(context: APIContext) {
+  if (!context.request.headers.get('content-type')?.startsWith('application/json')) throw new AuthError(415, 'Expected JSON.');
+  if (Number(context.request.headers.get('content-length')) > 65536) throw new AuthError(413, 'Request too large.');
+  try { return await context.request.json(); } catch { throw new AuthError(400, 'Invalid request.'); }
+}
+function text(value: unknown, label: string, max = 80): string {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value.trim() || value.length > max) throw new AuthError(400, `${label} is required and must be at most ${max} characters.`);
+  return value.trim();
+}
+function passwordText(value: unknown): string {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || !value || value.length > 1024) throw new AuthError(400, 'Enter your password.');
+  return value;
+}
+async function passwordVerification(username: string, password: string, register = false) {
+  const response = await fetch(`${IDENTITY_API}/${register ? 'register' : 'login'}`, {
+    method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify({ username, password }), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
+  });
+  if (!response.ok) throw new AuthError(register ? 400 : 401, register ? 'Could not create your account. Check your details or try another username.' : 'The username or password is incorrect.');
+}
+function summary(user: Account, rpId: string) {
+  return { user, rpId, credentials: passkeysFor(user.id).map(({ publicKey, counter, userId, ...key }) => key) };
+}
+const handle: APIRoute = async context => {
+  try {
+    if (!context.session) throw new AuthError(503, 'Account sessions are unavailable.');
+    const { origin, rpID } = configuration(context);
+    if (context.request.method !== 'GET' && context.request.headers.get('origin') !== origin) throw new AuthError(403, 'Request origin is not allowed.');
+    const action = context.params.action;
+    if (context.request.method === 'GET') {
+      if (action !== 'account') throw new AuthError(404, 'Not found.');
+      return json(summary(await signedIn(context), rpID));
+    }
+    if (context.request.method !== 'POST') throw new AuthError(405, 'Method not allowed.');
+    const data = await body(context);
+    if (action === 'logout') { context.session.destroy(); return json({ ok: true }); }
+    if (action === 'login' || action === 'signup') {
+      const username = text(data.username, 'Username');
+      const password = passwordText(data.password);
+      if (action === 'signup' && (password.length < 8 || !/\d/.test(password))) throw new AuthError(400, 'Use at least 8 characters and a number.');
+      await passwordVerification(username, password, action === 'signup');
+      const user = accountForUsername(username);
+      await establishSession(context, user);
+      return json({ user });
+    }
+    if (action === 'authentication/options' || action === 'reauthentication/options') {
+      const reauth = action.startsWith('reauthentication');
+      const user = reauth ? await signedIn(context) : undefined;
+      const keys = user ? passkeysFor(user.id) : [];
+      if (reauth && !keys.length) throw new AuthError(400, 'No passkeys yet. Verify with your password.');
+      const options = await generateAuthenticationOptions({ rpID, userVerification: reauth ? 'required' : 'preferred', allowCredentials: keys.map(key => ({ id: key.id, transports: key.transports })) });
+      context.session.set('challenge', { value: options.challenge, purpose: reauth ? 'reauthentication' : 'authentication', userId: user?.id, expires: Date.now() + 300000, requireUV: reauth } satisfies Challenge);
+      return json(options);
+    }
+    if (action === 'authentication/verify' || action === 'reauthentication/verify') {
+      const reauth = action.startsWith('reauthentication');
+      const user = reauth ? await signedIn(context) : undefined;
+      const challenge = await takeChallenge(context, reauth ? 'reauthentication' : 'authentication', user?.id);
+      const key = passkeyById(data.id);
+      if (!key) throw new AuthError(404, 'This passkey is no longer registered. Try another passkey or your password.');
+      if ((user && key.userId !== user.id) || (data.response?.userHandle && data.response.userHandle !== key.userId)) throw new AuthError(403, 'Use a passkey belonging to this account.');
+      const verification = await verifyAuthenticationResponse({ response: data, expectedChallenge: challenge.value, expectedOrigin: origin, expectedRPID: rpID, requireUserVerification: challenge.requireUV, credential: { id: key.id, publicKey: new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(key.publicKey, 'base64url')), counter: key.counter, transports: key.transports } });
+      if (!verification.verified) throw new AuthError(400, 'Passkey verification failed.');
+      updatePasskey({ ...key, counter: verification.authenticationInfo.newCounter, lastUsedAt: Date.now(), backedUp: verification.authenticationInfo.credentialBackedUp });
+      const account = accountById(key.userId)!;
+      if (reauth) context.session.set('verifiedAt', Date.now());
+      else await establishSession(context, account);
+      return json({ user: account });
+    }
+    const user = await signedIn(context);
+    if (action === 'reauthentication/password') {
+      await passwordVerification(user.username, passwordText(data.password));
+      context.session.set('verifiedAt', Date.now());
+      return json({ ok: true });
+    }
+    await requireRecent(context);
+    if (action === 'registration/options') {
+      const options = await generateRegistrationOptions({ rpName: 'The DevTools Times', rpID, userID: new Uint8Array(Buffer.from(user.id, 'base64url')), userName: user.username, userDisplayName: user.displayName, attestationType: 'none', excludeCredentials: passkeysFor(user.id).map(key => ({ id: key.id, transports: key.transports })), authenticatorSelection: { residentKey: 'required', requireResidentKey: true, userVerification: 'preferred' } });
+      context.session.set('challenge', { value: options.challenge, purpose: 'registration', userId: user.id, expires: Date.now() + 300000, requireUV: false } satisfies Challenge);
+      return json(options);
+    }
+    if (action === 'registration/verify') {
+      const challenge = await takeChallenge(context, 'registration', user.id);
+      const result = await verifyRegistrationResponse({ response: data, expectedChallenge: challenge.value, expectedOrigin: origin, expectedRPID: rpID, requireUserPresence: true, requireUserVerification: challenge.requireUV });
+      if (!result.verified || !result.registrationInfo) throw new AuthError(400, 'Passkey registration failed.');
+      const info = result.registrationInfo;
+      if (passkeyById(info.credential.id)) throw new AuthError(409, 'This passkey is already registered.');
+      insertPasskey({ id: info.credential.id, userId: user.id, publicKey: Buffer.from(info.credential.publicKey).toString('base64url'), counter: info.credential.counter, transports: info.credential.transports || [], name: 'My passkey', aaguid: info.aaguid, deviceType: info.credentialDeviceType, backedUp: info.credentialBackedUp, registeredAt: Date.now(), lastUsedAt: null });
+      return json(summary(user, rpID));
+    }
+    if (action === 'passkey/rename' || action === 'passkey/delete') {
+      const key = passkeyById(text(data.id, 'Passkey ID', 2048));
+      if (!key || key.userId !== user.id) throw new AuthError(404, 'Passkey not found.');
+      if (action.endsWith('rename')) updatePasskey({ ...key, name: text(data.name, 'Passkey name') });
+      else deletePasskey(key.id, user.id);
+      return json(summary(user, rpID));
+    }
+    if (action === 'profile') {
+      updateDisplayName(user.id, text(data.displayName, 'Display name'));
+      return json(summary(accountById(user.id)!, rpID));
+    }
+    throw new AuthError(404, 'Not found.');
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error instanceof AuthError) return json({ error: error.message }, error.status);
+    // Do not expose authenticator internals or upstream error bodies to clients.
+    console.warn('Account request failed:', error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown error');
+    return json({ error: 'We could not complete this request. Please try again.' }, 400);
+  }
+};
+export const GET = handle;
+export const POST = handle;

1. An overview of data protection

-

General information

-

The following information will provide you with an easy to navigate overview of what will happen with your personal data when you visit our website. The term “personal data” comprises all data that can be used to personally identify you. For detailed information about the subject matter of data protection, please consult our Data Protection Declaration, which we have included beneath this copy.

- -

2. General information and mandatory information

-

Data protection

-

The operators of this website and its pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. Hence, we handle your personal data as confidential information and in compliance with the statutory data protection regulations and this Data Protection Declaration.

-

Whenever you use this website, a variety of personal information will be collected. Personal data comprises data that can be used to personally identify you. This Data Protection Declaration explains which data we collect as well as the purposes we use this data for. It also explains how, and for which purpose the information is collected.

- -

3. Recording of data on our website

-

Cookies

-

In some instances, our website and its pages use so-called cookies. Cookies do not cause any damage to your computer and do not contain viruses. The purpose of cookies is to make our website more user friendly, effective and more secure. Cookies are small text files that are placed on your computer and stored by your browser.

+

The DevTools Times is a demonstration news site. You can read articles without creating an account. Use made-up credentials when trying the account forms.

+ +

Sign-in and sign-up

+

We request only a username and password to sign in or create a demo account. You do not need to provide a real name, email address, phone number, or date of birth. Choose a pseudonym and a password you do not use elsewhere.

+

Only when you submit a form, your browser sends these two fields over HTTPS to the external authentication service at us-central1-web-devrel-apps.cloudfunctions.net, using the times_cdn/api/login or times_cdn/api/register endpoint. That service also receives connection information such as your IP address and browser request headers. Our requests omit cookies and referrer information and do not follow redirects.

+

The forms keep entered values in page memory while you use them and clear the password after each submission attempt. They do not save credentials or returned authentication tokens in browser storage. Your browser or password manager may offer to save credentials according to your own settings.

+

This site's source does not establish how the external service stores credentials, how long it retains account data or logs, or how to access, correct, or delete an account. Those practices must be confirmed with the demo operator before using this service for real accounts. Do not submit real personal information or reuse a password.

+ +

Third-party resources and tracking

+

The shared page layout does not load third-party analytics or advertising scripts. The brand font is hosted with this site, so loading it does not contact Google Fonts. We do not collect form interaction analytics or use these forms for marketing.

+

Some articles include externally hosted images. Loading those images can disclose your IP address and browser request information to the image host. Our referrer policy prevents sending the referring page URL.

+ +

Reading list and cookies

+

The reading-list feature uses a server-side session to remember saved articles. A session is created when you save an article rather than simply visit the site; the session cookie lets the server find that list. You can remove saved items through the reading-list controls or remove this site's cookies using your browser settings to disconnect the browser from the list. Removing cookies does not itself delete any server-side records.

+

Some demonstration articles also set test cookies for their example API requests. These are separate from the account forms. The hosting service may maintain request logs; its retention settings are not defined in this application.

+ +

Browser privacy controls

+

Document responses disable camera, microphone, geolocation, motion sensors, and browsing-topics access through a Permissions Policy. Sign-in and sign-up responses instruct browsers and intermediaries not to cache them. These measures reduce unnecessary exposure but do not determine the external authentication service's handling of submitted data.
